# Official Data Sources

## NSE India
Historical index data and India VIX:
https://www.nseindia.com/all-reports
https://www.nseindia.com/static/resources/historical-reports-capital-market-daily-monthly-archives

## FRED
VIX: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/VIXCLS
US 10Y: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DGS10
Financial stress: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/

## World Bank
Country/indicator API:
https://datahelpdesk.worldbank.org/knowledgebase/articles/898590-country-api-queries

## RBI
RBI Database on Indian Economy:
https://data.rbi.org.in/

Download/export official observations and place them into the supplied templates.
